page.layout: One column, centred, on the title page: four printed lines, no running head, no page number, no catchword or signature.
page.notes: Dark bar at the top right corner and the scattered specks are scanner or paper artefacts, not print. The title is set in large capitals, with "LEXICON BREVE" in small capitals above it. "RABBINICO-" and "PHILOSOPHI-" keep their printed hyphens at the line ends. "CUM." is set with a small M and a full stop.
